title: I started using AI as my second opinion on trades and I'm kinda shocked how useful it is
author: galwithgall
selftext:
I've been experimenting with using an AI stock research site alongside my normal research before I buy/sell, and it's been way more useful than I expected.

Basically instead of just asking it "what stock should I buy," I've been using it to sanity check my thesis, look for risks I'm missing, compare companies, go through earnings/financials, and figure out whether I'm about to make a completely regarded decision.

Obviously I don't blindly follow what it says, but my decision making has gotten noticeably better since I started using it and my trading results have improved too.

The biggest benefit honestly isn't even finding stocks. It's having something actively argue against my thesis before I put money into it. I've backed out of a few trades after realizing there were pretty obvious things I hadn't considered.

The site I've been using is [Finchapp.ai](http://Finchapp.ai), if anyone wants to try it. No affiliation/referral link/whatever — I'm just a user and thought it was surprisingly useful.

Curious if anyone else here is actually using AI as part of their trading process yet, and if so, what are you using it for?
